source.description: Ignored local copy of one Motorsport Workbench manifest collection

track_aware_segmentation.method: PDS lap number plus start-finish geofence and duration validation

independent_reference_labels.origin: Run position weak labels, calculated independently of telemetry classifier features

confidence_calibration.policy: Review when confidence is below 0.75 or the top-two score margin is below 0.15

interpretation: The single classifier/reference disagreement is in the low-confidence band and is automatically routed to review.
Five correct classifications are also conservatively reviewed because the winning score margin is below policy.
Fourteen vehicle-stop events are context-expected near the end of in-laps and do not independently request review.
Two wheelspin candidates request review; they are diagnostic candidates rather than confirmed incidents.
All laps already require review for the known Milestone 3 yaw and accelerometer findings, so none is authorized downstream.
